searchText: Hi Hugo. We've been discussing this a fair amount here -- https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/706868829900505180/849090944325124136. My take is that the overall 20% overhead you find is probably not acceptable, that some (how many?) contracts will be slowed down a lot more than that, and that the added complexity of EVM implementations would be rather unfortunate. we're seeing `eth_gasPrice` return `0x0` at lot today, anyone else seeing anything similar? Trying to determine if it's a issue with the node being unstable or the GPO itself. actually I think it's an issue on our end, looks we are routing that RPC to some nodes without the recent GPO optimizations for some reason. ^ FWIW any geth nodes without Greg's GPO tweak or my `gpo.ignoreprice` option will be seeing lots of `0x0` gas estimates today, other clients might want to check what their `eth_gasPrice` has been returning too. thanks, I'm looking at the conversation there, yes the ~20% overhead is significant, the document is not considering this other impact on EVM performance which is something that also needs to be discussed <@!425343240212971521> it might be good to cross post that into the <#824798757618188339> which maybe become a catch-all for both the verkle stuff and the storage layout changes which would also include code merklization. <@!552133098075193354> I'm correct in assuming there's no chance of the London Ropsten fork still happening next week still right? Do we have an estimate on how far things might be pushed back yet? Thanks you! This is very useful Would be good to keep discussing in <#690694646241820682> (I'll put the rest of my comments there) Ah sorry, I saw <#690694646241820682> is archived Hmm, ok will go to <#706868829900505180> for now Correct. We’ll set the blocks on the next call, I think. (Assuming no other big issues and that clients generally feel ready, ofc). My proposal would be to push everything back 2 weeks, but no idea how clients feel about that and given all the chatter in <#749160974506000444>, it’s probably too early to ask.

excerpts.author: gcolvin
excerpts.content:
Hi Hugo.  We've been discussing this a fair amount here -- https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/706868829900505180/849090944325124136.

My take is that the overall 20% overhead you find is probably not acceptable, that some (how many?) contracts will be slowed down a lot more than that, and that the added complexity of EVM implementations would be rather unfortunate.

excerpts.content: we're seeing `eth_gasPrice` return `0x0` at lot today, anyone else seeing anything similar?  Trying to determine if it's a issue with the node being unstable or the GPO itself.

excerpts.content: actually I think it's an issue on our end, looks we are routing that RPC to some nodes without the recent GPO optimizations for some reason.

excerpts.content: ^ FWIW any geth nodes without Greg's GPO tweak or my `gpo.ignoreprice` option will be seeing lots of `0x0` gas estimates today, other clients might want to check what their `eth_gasPrice` has been returning too.
